name: tests-half-fx-resumable-lifecycle-startup-and-rollback
instr:
Fx cannot resume startup after cancellation or a deadline without repeating completed hook side effects. Implement attempt-bound checkpoints for App and fxtest without changing non-resumable lifecycle behavior.

A `StartCheckpoint` from `go.uber.org/fx` records the successfully completed append-order prefix. Exclude an interrupted callback unless it returns nil before startup returns. Resume at the first incomplete hook, advance monotonically, and never repeat completed callbacks. Before hooks or resume events run, reject foreign, completed, rolled-back, or stale checkpoints with `ErrInvalidCheckpoint`.

`StartWithCheckpoint` starts with nil or resumes from a returned checkpoint. Always return a `StartReport` with the underlying startup error. Ordinary hook failure rolls back the eligible prefix in reverse order, preserves error aggregation, and invalidates the attempt. A completed resumed startup stops every hook once in reverse order. An interrupted startup stops only its completed prefix.

Every accepted resume emits `ResumeStarted` then `ResumeFinished` from `go.uber.org/fx/fxevent`. ConsoleLogger, ZapLogger, and SlogLogger must represent the same attempt identity, completed count, completion status, and error meaning. ConsoleLogger renders both events and semantic fields. ZapLogger uses configured levels and structured fields. SlogLogger retains context without skip attributes. Replay observations buffered before logger connection once, in order, unchanged.
